story_type: rescue swimmer and basket lowered over breaking surf to a hiker on a roadless coast
hook: A hiker in distress on a coast with almost no roads.
narration: A rescue swimmer rode the cable down toward breaking surf on California's Lost Coast.
A 29-year-old hiker was in distress on the Lost Coast Trail, forty-five miles south of Humboldt Bay.
Almost no roads reach this stretch of shore, so a helicopter is often the only fast way out.
Next came the basket. It hangs from a single cable, so the hoist operator lowers it slowly to keep it from spinning.
It skimmed low over the sand and white water to reach her.
outcome: The Coast Guard aircrew hoisted the 29-year-old and medevaced her off the Lost Coast Trail.
title: Hiker in distress on the Lost Coast
description:
On May 18, 2017, the Coast Guard medevaced a 29-year-old hiker from the Lost Coast Trail, about 45 miles south of Humboldt Bay, California.
